caption:
Nasdaq-100 futures +1.5% before the bell as chips bounce and jobs beat forecasts (165,000 vs about 59,000 expected).

Dow futures were about -1% at 8:58 AM ET, and traders priced a >65% chance of a December Fed hike (Reuters, CME FedWatch).

Swipe: futures board, jobs numbers, pre-market movers, what to watch at 9:30.

Send this to a friend who trades. Midday update around 1 PM ET.

Pre-market prices are thin and can swing. Sources on the last slide. Educational content only. Not financial advice. Trading involves risk of loss.
